summary:
The 6-Day Cruise to Greek Islands & Turkey is a compact way to combine Athens with several Aegean ports in less than a week. Visit the Acropolis and the historic center of Athens before joining a three-night cruise calling at Mykonos, Kusadasi, Patmos, Crete and Santorini. The itinerary also crosses into Turkey at Kusadasi, the gateway to the ancient city of Ephesus, adding an archaeological stop to the island-focused route.
Sailings are available from April to October according to the cruise calendar. The six-day program includes 4-star hotel accommodation with breakfast, a 3-night full-board cruise, English-speaking local guides, transfers and scheduled sightseeing.

itinerary.title: Wednesday - Arrival to Athens
itinerary.text:
Arrival at Athens International Airport. Meet and transfer to your hotel in Athens.
Check-in after 14:00. The remainder of the day is at leisure. Overnight in Athens.

itinerary.title: Thursday- Half day Athens City Tour
itinerary.text:
Breakfast at the hotel.
Enjoy a half-day guided tour of Athens, including the Acropolis of Athens, Acropolis Museum, and Parthenon. Continue past the Parliament, Tomb of the Unknown Soldier, Presidential Palace, Panathenaic Stadium, Temple of Olympian Zeus, and Arch of Hadrian. The remainder of the day is at leisure. Overnight in Athens.

itinerary.title: Friday- Cruise Departure & Mykonos
itinerary.text:
Early morning transfer to Port of Piraeus for embarkation on your 3-night Greek Islands cruise.
Depart from Athens and begin your journey across the Aegean Sea. First stop is Mykonos, famous for its sandy beaches, crystal-clear waters, Little Venice, iconic windmills, lively cafés, shops, and nightlife.
Return to the ship as scheduled. Overnight on board.

itinerary.title: Saturday- Kusadasi & Patmos
itinerary.text: Arrival at Kusadasi in the morning. Optional excursion to Ephesus, one of the best-preserved ancient cities in the world. Continue cruising to Patmos with optional visits to the Monastery of Saint John the Theologian and the Cave of the Apocalypse. Overnight on board.

itinerary.title: Sunday- Heraklon ( Crete) Santorini
itinerary.text: Arrival at Heraklion in the morning. Optional excursion to the Palace of Knossos, center of the ancient Minoan Civilization. Continue sailing to Santorini, often linked to the legend of Atlantis. Enjoy stunning caldera views upon arrival. Overnight on board.

itinerary.title: Monday- Disembarkation & to Athens airport
itinerary.text:
Early morning arrival at Port of Piraeus. Breakfast on board followed by disembarkation.
Transfer to Athens International Airport. End of services.

faqs.q: What destinations are included in the Greece & Turkey Island Cruise?
faqs.a: The Greece & Turkey Island Cruise visits Athens, Mykonos, Santorini, Naxos, Crete, Rhodes, and Kusadasi. This itinerary combines Greece's most famous islands with a stop on Turkey's Aegean coast, offering a unique blend of ancient history, island culture, stunning beaches, and breathtaking Mediterranean scenery. The tour runs for 5 nights and 6 days.

faqs.q: How much does the Greece & Turkey Island Cruise cost?
faqs.a: The tour starts from €1,975 per person for the 2026 season. The price includes accommodation, cruise services, guided sightseeing tours, selected meals, and all airport, hotel, and port transfers specified in the itinerary. Final pricing may vary depending on travel dates, cabin category, and availability.

faqs.q: Is transportation between the islands included?
faqs.a: Yes, all cruise transportation between Athens, the Greek Islands, and Kusadasi is included according to the itinerary. The cruise provides a comfortable and scenic way to explore multiple destinations without the hassle of arranging separate transportation.

faqs.q: Are international flights included in the package?
faqs.a: No, international flights are not included in the tour price. Travelers are responsible for arranging their own flights to and from Greece. Magnificent Travel can assist with travel planning and recommendations if needed.

faqs.q: Does the Greece & Turkey Island Cruise include a guide?
faqs.a: Yes, professional English-speaking guides are included during the scheduled sightseeing tours. Your guides provide historical insights, cultural information, and local expertise throughout your journey across Greece and Turkey.

faqs.q: Is this tour suitable for first-time visitors to Greece and Turkey?
faqs.a: Yes, this tour is ideal for first-time visitors who want to experience the highlights of both countries in a short period. It combines famous Greek islands, rich history, beautiful coastal scenery, and a visit to the Turkish coast, making it a well-rounded Aegean adventure.

faqs.q: How fit do I need to be for the tour?
faqs.a: The physical difficulty is easy to moderate. Travelers should be comfortable walking through island towns, historic districts, ports, and archaeological areas. Most travelers in average health can comfortably participate throughout the itinerary.

faqs.q: What are the highlights of Mykonos, Santorini, Rhodes, Crete, and Kusadasi?
faqs.a: Mykonos is known for its lively atmosphere and charming whitewashed streets. Santorini offers spectacular caldera views and world-famous sunsets. Naxos provides authentic Greek island charm and beautiful beaches. Crete is celebrated for its rich history and local culture. Rhodes features a UNESCO-listed Medieval Old Town, while Kusadasi serves as the gateway to the ancient city of Ephesus.

faqs.q: What is the cancellation policy for the Greece & Turkey Island Cruise?
faqs.a: Free cancellation is available up to 90 days before the tour departure date. Cancellations made within 90 days may be subject to fees according to the booking terms, cruise conditions, and cancellation policy. Travel insurance is recommended for additional flexibility and protection.

faqs.q: Is the Greece & Turkey Island Cruise available all year and can it be customized?
faqs.a: The cruise operates seasonally according to cruise schedules and weather conditions. The itinerary can be customized with additional hotel nights before or after the cruise, hotel upgrades, optional excursions, or extended stays in Athens or the islands. Contact Magnificent Travel for a personalized itinerary and quotation.
